title: Taste-corpus decision list
description: Ground-truth editorial decisions recovered by aligning a raw recording's transcript against its professionally published edit. One file per raw->published pair. The contract between the corpus pipeline (tools/taste-corpus) and the agreement scorer (montage-eval). See docs/taste-gate-plan-2026-07-25.md.

house.description: Editorial house style the decisions belong to. Scores must never mix houses (Finding 13: taste polarity does not transfer).

speed.description: Playback factor for keep segments. Snapped to 1.0 when the measured ratio is below the trust threshold (auto-sub cue jitter, study caveat: sustained >=1.2x readings are trustworthy).

scope.description: cut segments only: where the cut falls relative to the published show's aligned span of the raw.
